real_defects.issue: #15153 added 19 EAS codes (0188 Japan, 0248 Oman, ...) to endpoint.mjs but not endpoint.py, document type 480 to document.mjs but not document.py, and E/Z/AE/K/G missing-percent-as-0 to linenet.mjs but not linenet.py: the Python CLI gave OpenPeppol's PINT JP example two false INV-039s and a 480 draft a false INV-032. Fixed in Python; tests/test_js_parity.py compares the three tables both ways.

Each test closes its server as its last line, so a failing assertion leaves it listening and node --test never exits: four caught mutants each hung the suite for 300 s. Fixed with an after() hook closing what is left; and about 40 other venture server suites share the pattern, so run_venture_tests.py now passes --test-force-exit (same 1580 results on einvoice-preflight with and without; regression test test_a_failing_test_that_leaves_a_server_open_fails_fast).

The Python CLI never reads CustomizationID, so it cannot drop INV-022/INV-035 under PINT profiles as report.mjs does: OpenPeppol's PINT JP example still draws both from Python. Fix needs: read CustomizationID in ubl.py, map it to the profile families report.mjs uses (pint, pint-jp/my/ae/om), and drop the same rule ids in cli.py; test against examples/pint-current-*.xml.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
